official_only_panel.definition: computed from game results and published schedule facts only - no operator prices

market_panel.definition: uses recorded prices from the mirror; labelled so it can never be quoted as an official-number correlation
market_panel.note: phi for the side/total parlay is reported separately in parlay-joint-evidence.json

parlay_joint.gate_status: OPEN for a two-leg same-game parlay IF an operator void/push rule is recorded; CLOSED while the void rule is unknown

historical_baseline_2015_2025.why: the pricing constant should come from the long window; this corpus is a sample, not a law

parlay_joint.small_sample_warning: the 130-game interval must overlap the long-window estimate before either is used; a phi of this size on n=130 is about 1.9 standard errors from zero
parlay_joint.why_still_blocked: A parlay may only be ranked when the validated joint probability AND the operator's void/push rules are both available. The joint term is now measured on two windows; the void rules are not, so no parlay is ranked.

suppressed.player_prop_leg_correlation: No prop price feed exists in this repository, so a prop combo's joint term cannot be measured. Withheld rather than assumed 0.
suppressed.correlation_between_designation_levels_a: Levels are not used as features (the brief requires a surprise, not a level), so no level correlation is published.
